title: Don't miss it
intro: The most expensive mistakes are the chances you do not see: a mate in one, a free queen, a defender with too many jobs.

lessons.title: Checks and captures first
lessons.summary: Look at every check and capture before anything else.

steps.text: Before you decide on a move, look at every check and every capture, for both sides. Many games are lost by players who did not look. Here Black has just taken on e4. Does White have a check?
Do not miss it: checkmate in one.
steps.hint: The queen and the bishop both aim at f7.
steps.ifWrong: There is a mate on the board. Check every queen move first.

steps.text: Captures next. Black's queen has wandered to d4, protected only by a pawn. A knight for a queen is a trade you should always take.

steps.hint: Which of your pieces attacks d4, and is worth less than a queen?
steps.ifWrong: Black's queen can be captured. Find the capture.
steps.ifRight: If the pawn takes back, you have still won 9 for 3.

feedback.d1d4: Queen takes queen and the pawn takes back: just a trade. Take with the knight and win 9 for 3.

lessons.title: The overloaded defender
lessons.summary: A piece with two jobs cannot do both.

steps.text: Black's queen has two jobs: she protects the knight on d5, and she guards e8 so that your rook cannot give mate on the back row.
Overload the queen: take the knight. If she takes back, she can no longer guard e8.
steps.hint: Your queen can capture on d5.
steps.ifWrong: Start by taking the knight with your queen.
steps.ifRight: Checkmate! The queen could not do both jobs.
